title: On the Impact of Feature Reduction Techniques on Adversarial Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2611.25004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adversarial attacks have posed significant threats to machine learning models by exploiting their inherent vulnerabilities. Researchers have established an interdisciplinary field called adversarial machine learning to explore these vulnerabilities and develop corresponding defense strategies. Feature reduction strategies are used to decrease the dimensionality of the data in order to reduce training time, avoid the curse of dimensionality, prevent overfitting, and mitigate redundant features. However, their effect on adversarial robustness across different classifiers and attack scenarios remains insufficiently explored. This study aims to analyze the effect of feature reduction techniques on the adversarial robustness of a diverse set of machine learning models under poisoning, backdoor, and universal adversarial perturbation attacks on the APT dataset. translated_title: 特征降维技术对对抗攻击的影响研究
translated_abstract: 对抗攻击通过利用机器学习模型固有的脆弱性，对其构成了重大威胁。研究人员建立了一个名为对抗机器学习的跨学科领域，以探索这些脆弱性并制定相应的防御策略。特征降维策略被用于降低数据维度，以减少训练时间、避免维度灾难、防止过拟合并缓解冗余特征。然而，特征降维在不同分类器和攻击场景下对对抗鲁棒性的影响仍未得到充分探索。本研究旨在分析特征降维技术对多样化机器学习模型对抗鲁棒性的影响，研究对象是在APT数据集上遭受投毒攻击、后门攻击和通用对抗扰动攻击的模型。这些模型包括支持向量机、决策树、随机森林、多……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究首次系统分析了特征降维技术（如减少维度）在APT数据集上遭受投毒、后门和通用对抗扰动攻击时，对支持向量机、决策树、随机森林等多种机器学习模型对抗鲁棒性的影响。
en_tdlr: This study systematically analyzes the impact of feature reduction techniques on the adversarial robustness of diverse machine learning models under poisoning, backdoor, and universal adversarial perturbation attacks on the APT dataset.
